title: Name the scope file lists in all_files.zip after the aspects
target_unit: exportJson() in DataExporter (unit of 61 LOC, file of 813 LOC, high risk)
notes: The reference change (+23/-7 without the commit's own test) replaces the five literal entry names read into all_files.zip by names derived from the configured scope aspects through the same function that writes the loose aspect_<name>.txt files, so a renamed aspect no longer raises NoSuchFileException inside exportJson's catch-all (which also skipped the git-history.zip written right after). The commit's own test calls the new package-private helper, so the acceptance test instead runs a real analysis of a two-file tree plus DataExporter.saveData into a @TempDir and asserts the zip's entry names (renamed aspect: aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt in place 4 plus git-history.zip present; default config: the historical five). Verification: A before = compiles, 1 of 2 tests fails (all_files.zip missing: NoSuchFileException on aspect_build_and_deployment.txt); A after (commit diff applied with patch -p1, the git-history streaming context of the real commit is absent in the snapshot but the hunk still lands) = passes, reports/cli/codeanalyzer/common tests green (356 tests); B before = same failure; B after (ported by hand into DataExporter.exportZips, the zip code stayed in DataExporter while the file-list text builders moved to FileListsDataExporter) = passes, all module tests green. Lands in A: DataExporter.java (813 LOC / 959 lines); in B: DataExporter.java (432 lines, exportZips()), with the writer-side names in FileListsDataExporter/DataExportUtils.
